root_dir.description: Use a different root directory when looking up for policies and OpenPGP keyrings.

gnupg_program.description: The name (or pathname) of the GnuPG program to use (DEBSIG_GNUPG_PROGRAM).

use_policy.description: Policy file name (without path) to use for verification. Overrides automatic selection.

quiet.description: Suppress all output except fatal errors (–quiet / -q).

verbose.description: Increase output verbosity to show execution steps (–verbose / -v).

list_policies.description: List policies that passed Selection phase, without verification (–list-policies).
